blocks.title: Indicator
blocks.text: Indicator woh madda hai jo titration ka end point (aakhri nuqta) dikhane ke liye rang badalta hai.

Acid-base indicators acid mein ek rang aur base mein doosra rang dikhate hain. Acid-base titration mein istemal hone wale zyada tar indicators weak organic acids ya weak organic bases hote hain. Solution mein weak-acid indicator (HIn) ko is equation se dikhate hain:
In⁻ indicator ke anion (manfi ion) hisse ki alamat hai. Reaction reversible hai, is liye HIn aur In⁻ dono maujood rehte hain. Rang is liye nazar aata hai ke HIn aur In⁻ ke rang mukhtalif hain.

Acidic solution mein jo In⁻ ions hain woh Brønsted bases ki tarah acid se protons le lete hain, is liye indicator zyada tar bina ionize hui shakal HIn mein hota hai. Basic solution mein base ke OH⁻ ions indicator ke H⁺ ions se mil jate hain (pani ban jata hai). H⁺ ki is kami ko poora karne ke liye indicator ke molecules aur ionize hote hain, aur indicator zyada tar apne anion In⁻ ki shakal mein aa jata hai. Ab solution base wala rang dikhata hai; litmus ke liye yeh neela hai.

blocks.alt: Chhoti neeli H goli bari surmai In goli se juri hai (HIn). Daen taraf teer 'In basic solution' aur baen taraf teer 'In acidic solution' neeli H goli (musbat charge) jama bari surkh In goli (manfi charge) ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.1: Un-ionised acid-base indicators aur un ki ionised shaklein equilibrium mein hoti hain (kitab ki doosri Figure 9.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Mukhtalif indicators mukhtalif pH par rang badalte hain. Rang is par munhasir hai ke us pH par HIn aur In⁻ kitni kitni miqdar mein hain. Misal: methyl red pH 4.4 aur 6.2 ke darmiyan surkh se peela hota hai. pH 4.4 par indicator zyada tar HIn molecules ki shakal mein hota hai, jo surkh nazar aate hain. Kuch aam indicators ki ranges neeche hain:

blocks.alt: pH 0 se 14 ke scale ke oopar do rangeen pattiyan. Methyl orange: kam pH par surkh, taqreeban pH 3.2 aur 4.5 ke darmiyan narangi se peela, us ke baad peela. Phenolphthalein: taqreeban pH 8.2 tak be-rang, pH 10 tak gulabi se surkh, us ke baad surkh.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2: Kuch aam acid-base indicators ki range aur rang ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Figure 9.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har patti ek indicator hai. Methyl orange acidic solution mein surkh hai aur pH taqreeban 4.5 se oopar peela; rang pH 3.2 se 4.5 ke darmiyan badalta hai. Phenolphthalein pH 8.2 tak be-rang hai aur 10 tak gulabi-surkh ho jata hai. Yani har indicator sirf apni chhoti si range mein rang badalta hai.

items: Indicator (weak organic acid ya base) HIn ⇌ H⁺ + In⁻: acid mein HIn ka rang, base mein In⁻ ka rang.
Har indicator ki apni pH range hai: methyl red pH 4.4 par surkh, 6.2 tak peela.
